source_requirement: The system shall not permit input of wrong data type.
The systems administrator should maintain the system and its databases to ensure integrity and availability of information.

The system shall provide authentication service which is tested when logging into the Django admin panel (back-end) of the system when the user logs into the system by entering the username and the password created by entering a command prompt when running the manage code.

The system shall use honeypot which records and analyses packets flowing through the network. A honeypot is a system decoy which is used to make the attacker believe that he/she is attacking the intended system.

The system shall ensure that, as a watermark is an essential part of data, it must continue even after signal processing and data manipulation including malicious operation that endeavors to remove the watermark.
